apps.name: home-assistant
apps.title: Home Assistant
apps.description: Runs your home from one place: lights, heating, cameras, locks and thousands of other devices, with automations that act on their own and a dashboard for every room. Works with what you already own, and keeps everything on your machine.

apps.name: mosquitto
apps.title: Mosquitto
apps.description: The message broker many smart devices and sensors talk through. Home Assistant and tools like Zigbee2MQTT use it to exchange readings and commands instantly, with nothing leaving your home.

apps.name: zigbee2mqtt
apps.title: Zigbee2MQTT
apps.description: Connects Zigbee bulbs, plugs, sensors and switches from any brand through one USB radio, without each maker's hub or app. Devices appear in Home Assistant automatically.

apps.name: esphome
apps.title: ESPHome
apps.description: Turns inexpensive ESP32 and ESP8266 boards into sensors, switches and displays you describe in a few lines, then updates them over Wi-Fi. Made to work with Home Assistant.

apps.name: node-red
apps.title: Node-RED
apps.description: Build automations by wiring blocks together on a canvas: when this happens, do that. Talks to Home Assistant, web services and devices, and suits rules too intricate for a form.

apps.name: z-wave-js-ui
apps.title: Z-Wave JS UI
apps.description: Runs your Z-Wave locks, thermostats, dimmers and sensors through one USB radio, with a control panel for pairing, healing the network and firmware updates. Hands everything to Home Assistant.

apps.name: music-assistant
apps.title: Music Assistant
apps.description: Plays your music library and streaming services on the speakers you already have, in any room or all of them at once, and takes voice requests through Home Assistant.

apps.name: frigate
apps.title: Frigate
apps.description: Records your security cameras and watches them for people, cars and animals, so you are alerted to what matters and can search what it saw. Clips and detections stay in your home.

apps.name: immich
apps.title: Immich
apps.description: Backs up every photo and video from your phones automatically, then lets the whole family browse, search and share them with faces, places and a timeline. Your own private photo cloud.

apps.name: photoprism
apps.title: PhotoPrism
apps.description: Organises your photo collection with automatic tagging, faces, places and a map, and finds pictures by what is in them. Good for bringing an old archive back to life.

apps.name: jellyfin
apps.title: Jellyfin
apps.description: Streams your films, series, music and live TV to every television, phone and tablet in the house, with artwork, subtitles and a watch history for each person. No subscription, no tracking.

apps.name: plex
apps.title: Plex
apps.description: Streams your film and music collection to any screen with a polished interface and apps for every device. The server runs in your home; a Plex account signs you in.

apps.name: audiobookshelf
apps.title: Audiobookshelf
apps.description: Keeps your audiobooks and podcasts in one library, remembers where everyone stopped, and plays them on the phone apps or in a browser. Downloads new podcast episodes for you.

apps.name: navidrome
apps.title: Navidrome
apps.description: Streams your own music collection to your phone, car and computer, with playlists, artist pages and scrobbling. Light enough to run anywhere, and works with dozens of player apps.

apps.name: romm
apps.title: RomM
apps.description: Catalogues your retro game collection with covers, descriptions and screenshots, and lets you play many of them right in the browser. For the games you own and grew up with.

apps.name: paperless-ngx
apps.title: Paperless-ngx
apps.description: Scan or drop in letters, bills, contracts and receipts; it reads them, tags them and makes every word searchable. Finding a document from years ago takes seconds.

apps.name: stirling-pdf
apps.title: Stirling PDF
apps.description: Merge, split, compress, sign, convert and edit PDFs in the browser, including scanned pages. Everything happens in your home, so nothing is uploaded to a stranger's website.

apps.name: syncthing
apps.title: Syncthing
apps.description: Keeps folders identical across your computers and phones, directly between them, with no account and no cloud in between. Change a file anywhere and it is everywhere.

apps.name: filebrowser
apps.title: File Browser
apps.description: Browse, upload, download, preview and share files from any browser, with a user for each member of the household. A simple front door to the files you keep at home.

apps.name: calibre-web
apps.title: Calibre-Web
apps.description: Browse your e-book collection with covers and metadata, read in the browser, and send books to a Kindle or other reader. Works from an existing Calibre library.

apps.name: kavita
apps.title: Kavita
apps.description: A reader for comics, manga, light novels and e-books that tracks progress for each person and syncs across devices. Fast, with a clean reading view on every screen.

apps.name: vaultwarden
apps.title: Vaultwarden
apps.description: Stores passwords, passkeys, cards and notes for the whole family, with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions you may already use. The vault stays in your home.

apps.name: adguard-home
apps.title: AdGuard Home
apps.description: Blocks ads and trackers for every device on your network at once, including smart TVs and phones, with parental controls and a view of what each device connects to.

apps.name: pi-hole
apps.title: Pi-hole
apps.description: Blocks ads and trackers for every device in the house before they load, with a dashboard showing what was stopped. One setting on your router and every screen is cleaner.

apps.name: joplin
apps.title: Joplin
apps.description: Syncs the Joplin note-taking apps on all your devices through your own home instead of someone's cloud. Notes, to-do lists and web clippings, end to end encrypted.

apps.name: memos
apps.title: Memos
apps.description: Jot down thoughts, links and snippets the moment they come, in a timeline you can tag and search. Lightweight, private, and open on every device.

apps.name: trilium
apps.title: Trilium Notes
apps.description: Build a personal knowledge base of nested notes with links, attachments and a canvas. Suited to large collections that outgrow a plain notes app.

apps.name: bookstack
apps.title: BookStack
apps.description: Write and organise documentation as books, chapters and pages: the house manual, recipes, how the Wi-Fi is set up, what the plumber did. Simple enough for everyone to edit.

apps.name: freshrss
apps.title: FreshRSS
apps.description: Follow websites, blogs, newsletters and video channels in one place, in the order they publish, with no algorithm deciding for you. Works with the reader apps on your phone.

apps.name: karakeep
apps.title: Karakeep
apps.description: Save links, articles, notes and images from your phone or browser, and find them again with full-text search and automatic tagging. Keeps a copy in case the page disappears.

apps.name: mealie
apps.title: Mealie
apps.description: Save recipes from any website with one click, plan the week's meals, and build a shopping list from them. Shared with the whole household, in the kitchen on a tablet.

apps.name: grocy
apps.title: Grocy
apps.description: Tracks what is in the pantry and the fridge, when it expires, and what needs buying, plus chores, batteries and anything else a home runs through.

apps.name: homebox
apps.title: Homebox
apps.description: Keep a record of what you own, where it is, what it cost and when the warranty ends, with receipts and photos attached. Useful for insurance, moving and finding things.

apps.name: vikunja
apps.title: Vikunja
apps.description: Shared to-do lists, projects and kanban boards for the household, with due dates, reminders and repeating tasks. Apps for phone and desktop sync through your home.

apps.name: radicale
apps.title: Radicale
apps.description: Keeps calendars and address books in sync across phones and computers through standard protocols, so the family calendar lives at home and works with the apps you already use.

apps.name: actual-budget
apps.title: Actual Budget
apps.description: Budget by envelope, import bank statements and see where the money goes, in a fast app that syncs between your devices through your home. Your finances stay yours.

apps.name: firefly-iii
apps.title: Firefly III
apps.description: Track accounts, budgets, bills and savings goals with detailed reports and rules that sort transactions for you. For people who want the full picture of their money.

apps.name: octoprint
apps.title: OctoPrint
apps.description: Start, watch and control your 3D printer from any browser, with a webcam view, time-lapses and plugins. No more walking SD cards to the printer.

apps.name: n8n
apps.title: n8n
apps.description: Connect apps and services into workflows: when a form is filled, a file arrives or a sensor fires, do the next steps automatically. Hundreds of integrations and a visual editor.

apps.name: open-webui
apps.title: Open WebUI
apps.description: A chat assistant that runs language models on your own hardware, so questions, documents and conversations never leave the house. Familiar interface, many models to choose from.
